svg.title: Dashboard concept with synthetic data
svg.desc: A concept of a project dashboard, with synthetic data. Mission control shows a project in its verifying stage, with 7 of 10 tasks verified (70 percent) and one approval waiting, and the next authorised action: re-run the checks on task 09 within budget, then get a fresh review. Work in flight shows the step each of three AI workers has reached on tasks 08, 09 and 10. Independent checks show 1,284 tests passed and none failed in the latest of 12 runs, with run 4's two failures fixed by run 5, and 2 of 3 reviews done today, 1 by another vendor; review 3 is for task 09 after its re-run. Verification shows 8 tasks reported by AI workers, 7 re-run by the AI coordinator, 7 reviewed by fresh AI reviewers and 7 verified, with the release waiting for a person. Human approvals show the release waiting and two decisions approved. Capacity shows 62 percent left for vendor X, 18 percent for vendor Y, and vendor Z as UNKNOWN and not used, with the readings taken 2 minutes ago.
